findings.claim: With Task 7 now required and behavior-graded (exactly two tests that must also catch two broken copies), the headline promises about 30 minutes in a 35-minute block, unlabelled as an estimate in the README; the figure is about half the lab's earlier authored median (55) and covers task work only, so README reading and setup consume much of the buffer for an average learner. Evidence: README line 3: 'sized to finish in about 30 minutes with a buffer left over inside the block'. lab.json minutes {estimatedMedian 30, cap 35}; notes: 'about 25 minutes for tasks 1 to 6 ... plus about 5 minutes for Task 7 ... Neither number is a measured learner pilot.'. authoring/evidence/html-css-js/dom-tooling-and-async/timing-critic-education-recheck.json edu-t2 records the earlier halving (55 to about 25) of this lab's median. Intake section Minute budgets: S26 leaves 54 minutes of Guided lab for this lab.
findings.recommendation: Label the README figure an authoring estimate (not a measured pilot); consider cap about 40-45, which still fits the 54 minutes S26 allocates and the 30-60 module-lab range, so average learners have a real buffer now that Task 7 is required.

findings.claim: Task 7's Hint 1 gives the first line, Hint 2 names both expressions to assert (formatDistance(5).label with toBe, formatDistance(11.5) with toEqual), and starter/format-distance.mjs documents both expected results; together they assemble the complete two-test file, leaving only test() wrappers to type. Hints are opt-in and the topic is low stakes, so this is not blocking, but the final hint is closer to the answer than 'none of them gives the full code' suggests. Evidence: README lines 108-109 (Hints 1 and 2). starter/format-distance.mjs comment: 'formatDistance(5) gives { km: 5, label: "5 km" }', 'formatDistance(11.5) gives { km: 11.5, label: "11.5 km" }'. Scratch probe under $TMPDIR (not committed): a file assembled from those hints passes Task 7; a tautological file (expected values computed by formatDistance) is rejected with 'with a formatDistance that returns a wrong label, both of your tests must fail ...'; a two-label-only file is rejected on wrong km; a one-test file is rejected with 'declare exactly two tests'.
findings.recommendation: Optional: let Hint 2 name the matchers' roles without naming both concrete inputs (for example 'pick one input from the comment for each test').
